description: This file defines functions for creating and logging network cache disk cache net log parameters, including data for read/write operations, sparse operations, and range results.

methods.name: NetLogReadWriteDataParams
methods.description: Creates a dictionary with parameters for a read/write data log entry.

methods.name: NetLogReadWriteCompleteParams
methods.description: Creates a dictionary with parameters for a read/write completion log entry.

methods.name: NetLogSparseOperationParams
methods.description: Creates a dictionary with parameters for a sparse operation log entry.

methods.name: NetLogSparseReadWriteParams
methods.description: Creates a dictionary with parameters for a sparse read/write log entry.

methods.name: CreateNetLogParametersEntryCreationParams
methods.description: Creates a dictionary with parameters for creating a net log entry for a cache entry.

methods.name: CreateNetLogGetAvailableRangeResultParams
methods.description: Creates a dictionary with parameters for range result log entries.
